```yaml
name: Regenerate translations

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - lib/l10n/*.arb
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - lib/l10n/*.arb

jobs:
  regenerate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          flutter-version: stable
          channel: stable

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: flutter pub get

      - name: Activate intl_utils
        run: flutter pub global activate intl_utils

      - name: Generate translations
        run: flutter pub global run intl_utils:generate

      - name: Create pull request
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: regenerate translations"
          branch: regen-translations-${{ github.run_id }}
          title: "chore: regenerate translations"
          body: |
            This PR was automatically generated by the GitHub Actions workflow to regenerate translation files.
```
